source_url: https://arxiv.org/e-print/1505.05560 (LaTeX source of Ogrean et al. 2015, ApJ 812, 153, arXiv:1505.05560)
exact_query: Table 'Cluster properties in R500' (global-model-tab.tex) and Section 'Global X-Ray Properties' (global_properties.tex) plus the NE-core density sentence in N_cluster.tex, from the arXiv e-print tarball for 1505.05560
extraction: Transcribed verbatim from the published LaTeX tables/text in the arXiv e-print source. Raw .tex files kept in raw_paper_tables/macsj0416_ogrean2015_*.tex.
note: MACS J0416.1-2403 (z=0.396). Instrument: Chandra ACIS-I, 5 ObsIDs, ~324 ks total. *** GLOBAL TEMPERATURE ONLY - THERE IS NO TABULATED RADIAL n_e(r) OR T(r) PROFILE *** kT = 10.06 (+0.50/-0.49) keV. *** NOT CORE-EXCISED *** : the spectrum was extracted from a FULL CIRCLE of radius 1.2 Mpc (approximately R500, from Sayers et al. 2013) centred at 04:16:08.8 -24:04:14.0, with no central region removed. Ogrean et al. do publish surface-brightness profiles and beta-model / broken-power-law fits, but only for narrow SECTORS chosen to study merger shocks and cold fronts, and the best-fit parameters appear only in FIGURES, not in any table - so no azimuthally averaged profile is machine-readable from this paper.
reference: Ogrean, van Weeren, Jones, Clarke, Sayers, Mroczkowski, Nulsen, Forman, Murray, Pandey-Pommier, Randall, Churazov, Bonafede, Kraft, David (2015), 'Frontier Fields Clusters: Chandra and JVLA View of the Pre-Merging Cluster MACS J0416.1-2403', ApJ 812, 153; arXiv:1505.05560
